name: kartograf
description: Code map (symbols, references, call graph) of PHP, Go and TypeScript projects for AI agents.
long_description: kartograf indexes a project with tree-sitter into SQLite (incremental, FTS5) and serves it over MCP: symbol search, declarations with source, references, callers and callees, class hierarchy, impact analysis, full-text code search and a per-branch handoff note that lets a new chat resume a task. PHP, Go and TypeScript/JavaScript are supported; an optional enrichment layer (go/types, PHPStan) adds exact type-resolved edges. Everything runs locally; the index lives in the user cache directory.

project_dir.title: Project directory
project_dir.description: Root of the codebase to index and serve: one repository, or a folder of repositories.
